content.title: The Godfather
content.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

Title: The Godfather

Tagline: An offer you can't refuse.

Overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

Genres: Drama, Crime

Collection: The Godfather Collection

Production Companies: Paramount Pictures, Alfran Productions, Albert S. Ruddy Productions

Production Countries: United States of America

Spoken Languages: English, Italian, Latin
